name: Baby Food Chewing Mash & Serve Bowl for Homemade Baby Food
description:
Make mealtime easier and safer for your little one with the Applebear Baby Mash and Serve Bowl. Made from high-quality food grade plastic, this lightweight and durable bowl is designed for babies aged 0–4 years. Its antibacterial and anti-virus properties ensure safety and hygiene, while the long-reach handles of the masher make mashing food effortless. The bowl is also microwave safe, allowing you to heat food quickly and conveniently.

Brand: Applebear

Material: Food grade plastic

Colour: Multicolor

Age Group: 0–4 Years

Features:

Safety and health focused

Antibacterial and anti-virus

Long reach masher handles

Microwave safe

Product Weight: Lightweight

Country of Origin: China
